layout.note: Fresh review of all 11 rows in both languages at agent-5 isolated snapshot 1a908eac (parent d0fb5765, the snapshot I reviewed last). The row order, the cuts and the two joins (r00003 with r00004, r00005 with r00006) are the same as in the layout I accepted before. What changed: eight verse rows went from recitation to quotation. Six uncut rows (r00007, r00009 to r00013) keep their IDs. The two joined rows have new IDs: m7fd11ac1993a4b4f9d3db507 is now m8295de084366aef28d7b3740 and m593b5e8d63e327587f6fea00 is now m9fabefe023a95654ead5e658. Mapping, checked separately from the kinds with my script check-role-revision.mjs (21 checks, all pass): no text reference and no attribution changed in any row; no pooled text file changed; each of the two retired joined IDs is an alias holding the exact old row and pointing to the whole field of the new row at offset 0; the two earlier aliases (r00003-s3230365f4763acdc, r00005-sbd4e608dd116bf2e) are carried with the same offsets; the two further aliases (r00003-sce35a6075dcf1b56, r00005-s0f9a18f36d608878) are the left sides of the re-made joins and were never published before; no new ID existed in any earlier version; the mapping of all 13 frozen rows is the same apart from the two renamed target rows; plan and layout differ only in kinds; the project's canonical check rebuilds the published item and mapping from plan and layout. Link check over every row ID published for this item since the frozen base (19 ID meanings in 5 versions, 3231 code points): every code point opens the same character in the current rows. Two proposed spaces, each reviewed in its own entry. The kind finding I held open on the eight verse rows is closed by this change. This is a reviewer's acceptance of the split, roles and mapping; it is not a scholarly or rights approval, and it approves no provisional historical-link candidate.

spacing_review.reason: Separate the Arabic verse ending النَّقَدِ from the following وَ; the Persian rendering covers both verse halves.
spacing_review.note: Accepted, reviewed afresh for the re-made row at 1a908eac. Left side r00003-sce35a6075dcf1b56 fills offsets 0-58 and right side r00004 fills offsets 60-117 of the 118 code points; offset 59 is one U+0020 and the only character added. The code point before it is the last letter mark of a complete word and the code point after it starts a separate one-letter conjunction, so without the space two words would run together. The field has no doubled space. Same position, value and reason as the space I accepted in the old row m7fd11ac1993a4b4f9d3db507; the old row's alias maps offset 59 to this same offset. A plain space (not the three-asterisk divider of the second poem) is right: the source writes r00007 of this same poem with plain spaces only. The Persian field comes whole from r00004 and has no junction.
